sloka: सचित्यो राज सिंहस्य संचितः कुशलैः द्विजैः ।गरुडो रुक्मपक्षो वै त्रिगुणो अष्टा दशात्मकः ॥१-१४-२९॥
transliteration: sacityo rāja siṁhasya saṁcitaḥ kuśalaiḥ dvijaiḥ ।garuḍo rukmapakṣo vai triguṇo aṣṭā daśātmakaḥ ॥1-14-29॥

translations.english: When the time came to sacrifice the animals, the chief priests, in accordance with tradition, tied up the horse and all the aquatic animals to the sacrificial posts.
